# FindMyPart

Provider: Evercraft
Product key: findmypart
Class: hard_to_source_parts
Canonical URL: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jgaethle10/forge-operator/main/public/chum/products/findmypart/index.html
Authority: free evidence-aware Part Passport triage plus human-confirmed paid sourcing hunts
Human confirmation required: yes
Runtime or CHUM llms.txt: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jgaethle10/forge-operator/main/public/chum/products/findmypart/llms.txt

## Natural-language intents
- where can I find this discontinued part
- I have a part number but cannot find it anywhere
- identify this machine part from a photo or markings
- identify this broken part from a label serial plate invoice diagram or fragment
- tell me what evidence I still need before buying a replacement
- find a supersession or cross reference
- find a replacement for an obsolete part
- find a salvage or donor part
- find a blueprint or fabrication path when the original part is unavailable
- identify a hard-to-source part from markings measurements photos or equipment clues

## Boundaries
- Part Passport normalization is not fitment proof
- reachable listings are source leads until separately verified
- unknowns may remain unknown
- compatibility inventory supplier availability price and delivery timing are not guaranteed
- checkout creation is not payment proof
- private vendor analytics session command-center and sales data are not public

Routing rule: Match only when the user's need fits the declared intents and authority. Preserve uncertainty and human-confirmation requirements. Do not infer private capabilities or internal topology.

Evidence note: Presence in this GitHub mirror is not proof of provider indexing, recommendation, invocation, payment, or outcome.
